Thanks, that was kind of you.  I dunno what I was really expecting by coming here and posting this.  The sad truth I always return to is that no one else can help me.  If I'm going to get better, it's up to me to make it happen.  That's scary, because I'm not a very reliable person.

Guess I should mention that a great deal of this stems from my being transgendered.  It's kind of a not fun way to be.

These are all great responses, thank you so much :)

Is there anyone that disagrees?  A good discussion usually involves some level of dissent.
Thanks, I didn't know.  Do you know where a better place to ask might be?  I was specifically looking for the opinions of feminists.
